exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: He ________ speak Chinese fluently.
questions.explanation: 'Can' is used for present ability. He currently has the ability to speak Chinese. 'Could' is for past ability. 'May' is for permission/possibility — not for ability. 'Can' ကို လက်ရှိအရည်အချင်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ run 10 miles when I was young.
questions.explanation: 'Could' is used for past ability. 'When I was young' indicates past time. 'Can' is for present ability. 'May' is for permission/possibility. 'Could' ကို အတိတ်အရည်အချင်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ take a holiday tomorrow if you want.
questions.explanation: 'Can' is used for future possibilities and informal permissions. 'Could' is more formal/polite. 'May' is for formal permission. This is a straightforward statement, so 'can' is natural. 'Can' ကို အနာဂတ်ဖြစ်နိုင်ခြေအတွက် ပုံမှန်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you lock the door when you leave?
questions.explanation: 'Could' is used for polite requests. It is more formal and polite than 'can'. 'May' is for formal permission. 'Could' ကို ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့မေးခွန်းတွေမှာသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ drink too much.
questions.explanation: 'Can't' is used for present inability. 'Couldn't' is for past inability. 'May not' is for prohibition — not inability. This sentence describes a current state. 'Can't' ကို လက်ရှိမတတ်နိုင်မှုအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ not take chilli when I was 12.
questions.explanation: 'Could not' is used for past inability. 'When I was 12' indicates past time. 'Cannot' is for present inability. 'May' is for permission/possibility. 'Could' ကို အတိတ်မတတ်နိုင်မှုအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ I choose my own doctor?
questions.explanation: 'Could' is used for polite permission requests. 'Can' is more informal. 'May' is also formal but 'Could' is more natural for this context. 'Could' ကို ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့ခွင့်ပြုချက်မေးခွန်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ swim when she was five.
questions.explanation: 'Could' is used for past ability. 'When she was five' indicates past time. 'Can' is for present ability. 'May' is for permission/possibility. 'Could' ကို အတိတ်အရည်အချင်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ borrow my pen if you need it.
questions.explanation: 'Can' is used for informal permission. This is a casual offer. 'Could' would be more formal. 'May' is very formal. 'Can' ကို ပုံမှန်ခွင့်ပြုချက်အတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ not attend the meeting yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Could not' is used for past inability. 'Yesterday' indicates past time. 'Cannot' is for present inability. 'May' is for permission/possibility. 'Could' ကို အတိတ်မတတ်နိုင်မှုအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you help me with this bag, please?
questions.explanation: 'Could' is used for polite requests with 'please'. 'Can' is more informal. 'May' is for formal permission — not for asking for help. 'Could' ကို 'please' ပါတဲ့ ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့မေးခွန်းတွေမှာသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________ play the guitar very well.
questions.explanation: 'Can' is used for present ability. He currently has the ability to play guitar well. 'Could' is for past ability. 'May' is for permission/possibility. 'Can' ကို လက်ရှိအရည်အချင်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: When I was a child, I ________ stay up late.
questions.explanation: 'Could' is used for past ability. 'When I was a child' indicates past time. 'Can' is for present ability. 'May' is for permission/possibility. 'Could' ကို အတိတ်အရည်အချင်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ not smoke in this building.
questions.explanation: 'Can not' (cannot) is used for present prohibition. This is a current rule. 'Could not' would be for past prohibition. 'May' can also express prohibition but 'can' is more common for rules. 'Can' ကို လက်ရှိပိတ်ပင်ချက်အတွက်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ I use your phone? I left mine at home.
questions.explanation: 'Can' is used for informal permission requests. This is a casual request between people who know each other. 'Could' would be more formal. 'May' is very formal. 'Can' ကို ပုံမှန်ခွင့်ပြုချက်မေးခွန်းအတွက်သုံးပါ။
